## T09. Scale-\(L^2\) direct detectors

### T09a. One fixed Möbius profile

Let
\[
V(u)=e^{-u-u^{-1}},\quad
\phi(u)=(uV(u))',\quad
S_\phi(x)=\sum_{n\ge1}\mu(n)\phi(n/x).
\]
For \(0<a<1\), suppose for every \(\epsilon>0\) and every sufficiently large dyadic \(X\),
\[
\int_X^{2X}|S_\phi(x)|^2\,\frac{dx}{x}
\ll_\epsilon X^{2a+\epsilon}. \tag{T09.1}
\]
Then \(\zeta\) has no zeros in \(\Re s>a\).

Indeed, on \(\Re s\ge a+\delta\), Cauchy bounds the Mellin contribution of one shell by \(X^{-\delta+\epsilon/2}\). Taking \(\epsilon<2\delta\) makes the dyadic sum and every fixed complex derivative converge locally uniformly. At zero the function is exponentially small. Thus
\[
F(s)=\int_0^\infty S_\phi(x)x^{-s}\frac{dx}{x}
\]
is holomorphic for \(\Re s>a\). Initially \(F(s)=\Phi(s)/\zeta(s)\), where [restricted research revision] proves
\[
\Phi(s)=2(1-s)K_s(2).
\]
For completeness, a zero \(K_s(2)=0\) would give \(f(t)=K_s(2e^t)\), \(t\ge0\), with Dirichlet boundary and
\[
\int_0^\infty(|f'|^2+4e^{2t}|f|^2)\,dt
=-s^2\int_0^\infty|f|^2\,dt>0.
\]
Hence such \(s\) is purely imaginary. Therefore \(\Phi\) has no zeros in \(\Re s>0\) except \(1\). Continue
\[
(s-1)\zeta(s)F(s)=(s-1)\Phi(s).
\]
Any proposed zeta zero in \(\Re s>a\) contradicts the nonzero right side. No uniform lower bound for \(\Phi(\sigma+it)\) is used.

The exact positive scale kernel is
\[
\int_X^{2X}|S_\phi(x)|^2\frac{dx}{x}
=\sum_{m,n}\mu(m)\mu(n)
\int_1^2\phi(m/(Xt))\overline{\phi(n/(Xt))}\frac{dt}{t}.
\]
The arithmetic coefficients retain signs and all shared primes.

### The exact full shift kernel and its affordable diagonal

Define
\[
 K_X(m,n)=\int_1^2\phi(m/(Xt))\overline{\phi(n/(Xt))}\,\frac{dt}{t}.
\]
Absolute convergence, using the rapid decay of \(\phi\) at both ends, permits the exact regrouping
\[
 \int_X^{2X}|S_\phi(x)|^2\frac{dx}{x}
 =\sum_{n\ge1}\mu(n)^2K_X(n,n)
 +2\Re\sum_{h\ge1}\sum_{n\ge1}\mu(n)\mu(n+h)K_X(n,n+h).
 \tag{T09.1a}
\]
The diagonal is \(O(X)\): uniformly for \(1\le t\le2\), integer counting gives \(\sum_n|\phi(n/(Xt))|^2\ll X\), and then integrate in \(t\). It is separately affordable for \(a\ge1/2\), including every intended numerical target. For \(a<1/2\), cancellation between this diagonal and the off-diagonal would still be required. More generally,
\[
 |K_X(m,n)|\ll_A (1+m/X)^{-A}(1+n/X)^{-A}.
\]
This bound follows directly from the upper-end Schwartz bounds for each factor; the lower-end decay only improves it. It justifies the regrouping and tail truncations with explicit losses, but gives no short-shift support. When \(m,n\asymp X\), differences of order \(X\) remain. Thus the next sufficient estimate is for the complete signed weighted off-diagonal in (T09.1a), including shared-prime and product coincidences. A fixed-shift theorem alone does not establish (T09.1). This exact decomposition and diagonal bound are an additional merger result used in portfolio F01.N1.

### Frozen-dyad balanced finite form

Set, for large \(X\),
\[
L=\log X,\quad Y=\lfloor\sqrt X/L^2\rfloor,\quad
T_l=X/L^4,\quad T_u=XL^2,\quad J=\lceil8L^6\rceil.
\]
Use [restricted research revision]'s fixed smooth cutoffs \(\rho,\chi\), and define on \(x\in[X,2X]\)
\[
\mathcal B_X(x)=
\sum_{d,e>Y}\mu(d)\mu(e)
\rho(de/T_l)\chi(de/T_u)
\sum_{\ell\le J}\phi(\ell de/x).
\]
For every \(A>0\) and fixed Euler derivative order \(r\),
\[
(x\partial_x)^r\{S_\phi(x)-\mathcal B_X(x)\}
=O_{A,r}(X^{-A}). \tag{T09.2}
\]
This is a bounded extension of [restricted research revision] V7–V8, not a new cancellation estimate.

To prove it, apply the exact Möbius convolution identity with the same arithmetic cutoff \(Y\) throughout the dyad. The short Möbius term is exponentially small. In the Type-I term \(de/x\le L^{-4}\); lower removed Type-II products have \(de/x\le2L^{-4}\). [restricted research revision] V6's complete Poisson cancellation bounds these by \(e^{-cL^2}\) before truncating the \(\ell\)-sum. The infinite upper product tail has \(de/x\ge L^2/2\) and is likewise superpolynomially small after divisor counting. On the retained support \(Jde/x\ge4L^2\), so truncating \(\ell>J\) costs the same. There are \(O(XL^3)\) retained pairs, all with
\[
\sqrt X/L^2<d,e<2\sqrt X L^4.
\]
Every arithmetic cutoff is fixed on the dyad; differentiating only changes the smooth profile. The same endpoint estimates hold for each fixed Euler derivative. Replacing \(S_\phi\) by \(\mathcal B_X\) in (T09.1) changes energy by \(O_A(X^{-A})\) after reserving a larger preliminary \(A\).

At \(a=.87449\), the target squared-energy exponent is \(1.74898\). The gain over the inherited baseline squared-energy bound is \(0.000793294079928262\ldots\). The energy estimate remains open; averaging does not erase a hypothetical \(x^\rho\) mode.

### T09b. Compact-profile triple-convolution criterion

Let \(P_r(y)\) be the exact [restricted research revision] Z13–Z15 triple convolution, including equal-element projection, fixed good sectors, and all cube/core overlaps. For \(5/6<a<1\), suppose
\[
\int_Y^{2Y}\int_1^2|P_r(y)|^2\,dr\,\frac{dy}{y}
\ll_\epsilon Y^{\,2(3-2a)-\epsilon} \tag{T09.3}
\]
for every sufficiently small dyadic \(Y\) and every \(\epsilon>0\). Then \(\zeta_K^S\), and hence \(\zeta\), is zero-free in \(\Re s>a\).

Take \(H=L^2([1,2],dr)\) and \(P(y)=(P_r(y))_r\). Cauchy gives, on \(\Re s\ge a+\delta\),
\[
\left\|\int_Y^{2Y}P(y)y^{2s-3}\frac{dy}{y}\right\|_H
\ll Y^{2(\Re s-a)-\epsilon/2}.
\]
Choose \(\epsilon<4\delta\). The Bochner Mellin integral is holomorphic; large \(y\) decays exponentially uniformly on the compact \(r\)-interval. Initially its exact value is
\[
J_\bullet(s)
\frac{L^S(3s-3/2,\xi_{\rm ang})}{\zeta_K^S(s)},
\quad
J_r(s)=\int_0^\infty t^{2s}K_{1/3}(\kappa t)^2
K_{1/3}(\kappa rt)\,dt.
\]
For fixed \(\Re s>0\), \(r\mapsto J_r(s)\) is analytic on \(r>0\). [restricted research revision] Z16 proves a nonzero gamma-product limit for \(r^{1/3}J_r(s)\) as \(r\downarrow0\). Therefore \(J_r(s)\) cannot vanish almost everywhere on \([1,2]\); its \(H\)-norm is positive. The angular numerator is nonzero because \(3\Re s-3/2>1\). Continue the identity after multiplication by \((s-1)\zeta_K^S(s)\), and evaluate at a hypothetical zero. The right side is a nonzero vector, contradiction.

This removes the need for estimates uniform as \(r\to0\) or an individual zero-free kernel \(J_1\). It does not supply the arithmetic decay. At \(a=.87449\), the squared \(Y\)-exponent is \(2.50204\); \(N=Y^{-2}\) is a different scale.

**Sources:** BB R06–R07; [restricted research revision] V1–V10; [restricted research revision] Z13–Z18.

## T10. Two-dilation and continuum-dilation Möbius criteria

Fix \(0<\alpha<1\) and \(\Delta_bM(x)=M(bx)-b^\alpha M(x)\), where \(M(x)=\sum_{n\le x}\mu(n)\).

### Two discrete dilations

If for every \(\epsilon>0\) and all sufficiently large integers \(N\),
\[
\sum_{b\in\{2,3\}}\sum_{N\le n<2N}|\Delta_bM(n)|^2
\ll N^{2a+1+\epsilon},\qquad 0<a<1, \tag{T10.1}
\]
then \(\zeta\) is zero-free in \(\Re s>a\).

On a unit interval, \(|M(bx)-M(b\lfloor x\rfloor)|\le b\), while \(M(x)=M(\lfloor x\rfloor)\). Thus (T10.1) gives the continuous dyadic \(L^2(dx/x)\) estimate with an affordable \(O(1)\) error on a shell. The shell argument of T09 yields holomorphy of
\[
\int_0^\infty\Delta_bM(x)x^{-s}\frac{dx}{x}
=\frac{b^s-b^\alpha}{s\zeta(s)}. \tag{T10.2}
\]
Both multipliers can vanish only at
\[
s=\alpha+\frac{2\pi i m}{\log2}
 =\alpha+\frac{2\pi i n}{\log3}.
\]
The irrationality of \(\log2/\log3\) forces \(m=n=0\). The remaining real point \(\alpha\) is not a zeta zero: the alternating eta series is positive on \(0<s<1\), and \(1-2^{1-s}<0\). Thus at least one multiplier retains every prospective nontrivial zero. Their inverses need not be uniformly bounded in height.

The exact consistency identity is
\[
\Delta_2M(3x)-3^\alpha\Delta_2M(x)
=\Delta_3M(2x)-2^\alpha\Delta_3M(x).
\]
It gives no contraction or decay without a new arithmetic estimate.

### New continuum-dilation variant

Replace (T10.1) by
\[
\int_X^{2X}\int_2^3|\Delta_bM(x)|^2\,db\,\frac{dx}{x}
\ll X^{2a+\epsilon}. \tag{T10.3}
\]
The same conclusion follows by taking the Mellin integral in \(L^2([2,3],db)\). Its multiplier vector is \(m_s(b)=b^s-b^\alpha\). It vanishes as a vector only for \(s=\alpha\): a nonconstant exponential in \(\log b\) cannot be identically one on an interval.

This compact continuum also provides a useful quantitative calibration absent from the discrete two-multiplier claim. Put
\[
G_\alpha(s)=\int_2^3|b^s-b^\alpha|^2\,db.
\]
For \(\sigma\) in any fixed compact real interval,
\[
G_\alpha(\sigma+it)\gg1\qquad(|t|\ge1), \tag{T10.4}
\]
with a constant depending on that interval and \(\alpha\). Expanding the square, the cross term is
\[
2\Re\int_2^3 b^{\sigma+\alpha+it}\,db=O((1+|t|)^{-1}),
\]
uniformly in the compact \(\sigma\)-interval; the two diagonal integrals have a positive lower bound. This proves the assertion for large \(t\). Continuity and the absence of zeros prove it on the remaining compact set \(1\le|t|\le T_0\). Near \(s=\alpha\),
\[
G_\alpha(s)=|s-\alpha|^2
\int_2^3 b^{2\alpha}(\log b)^2\,db
 +O(|s-\alpha|^3).
\]
Thus the sole calibration zero is known and simple at the multiplier level; zeta is nonzero there. The proposed continuum energy is nevertheless an open Möbius estimate.

The same hypothesis has a quantitative consequence: on every compact strip \(a<\sigma_0\le\Re s\le\sigma_1\), with \(|\Im s|\ge1\),
\[
 |1/\zeta(s)|\ll_{\sigma_0,\sigma_1,\alpha}1+|\Im s|. \tag{T10.5}
\]
Indeed the shell bounds give an absolutely convergent Bochner Mellin integral \(F(s)\) whose norm is uniformly bounded on that strip; its defining norm integral has no imaginary-height growth. The exact identity is \(\|F(s)\|=\sqrt{G_\alpha(s)}/|s\zeta(s)|\). Combine it with (T10.4). This is conditional on the same open continuum energy, not on any additional arithmetic hypothesis.

On logarithmic scale, \(f(t)=e^{-\alpha t}M(e^t)\) converts \(\Delta_bM(e^t)\) to \(b^\alpha e^{\alpha t}[f(t+\log b)-f(t)]\). An averaged finite-difference/Poincaré approach is therefore an explicit next construction. It must estimate these actual increments, not invoke a generic inequality to create a Möbius power saving.

**Sources:** BA D11 for the discrete construction; continuum construction developed and independently proved during the merge.

      (leftCoefficient e (activeConductor C D)
          (finiteSexticRow (activePrime C D) (activeGood C D hC) (activeExponent C D)) n *
          idealRowHom j (Ideal.span {n}) =

          leftCanceledMask C D n) ∧
      (rightCoefficient e (activeConductor C D)
          (finiteSexticRow (activePrime C D) (activeGood C D hC) (activeExponent C D)) n *
          idealRowHom j (Ideal.span {n}) =
        elementCoeff ηR n *

statement:
theorem actual_momentData_density {Label : Type*} [Fintype Label]
    (η : Label → Character) (Q : Ideal O) [NeZero Q]
    (hQtop : Q ≠ ⊤) (hQ72 : Q ≤ Ideal.span {(72 : O)})
    (hQη : ∀ label, Q ≤ (η label).modulus)
    (hβ : (51/100 : ℝ) ≤ HeckeZeroSupremum.beta)
    (M : Ideal O) [NeZero M] (H : Subgroup (O ⧸ M)ˣ)
    (hH : RayOrthogonality.globalUnits M ≤ H) (S : Finset (Ideal O))
    (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ) (hφc : HasCompactSupport φ)
    (hφp : tsupport φ ⊆ Ioi 0) (hφ0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ φ y) (hφne : φ ≠ 0)
    (a₀ b₀ B₀ : ℝ) (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) (hab₀ : a₀ ≤ b₀) (hB₀ : 0 < B₀)
    (hφs : Function.support φ ⊆ Ioo a₀ b₀) (hφB : ∀ y, φ y ≤ B₀)
    (hβupper : HeckeZeroSupremum.beta ≤ 7/8)
    (loss : ℝ) (hlosspos : 0 < loss) :
    ∃ (A : ℕ) (K : ℝ), 0 < K ∧
      (∀ Y : ℝ, 1 ≤ Y → ∀ p : DensityWindow, ∀ F : Finset FreeRow,
        (∀ u ∈ F, rowNorm u ≤ Y ∧ rawZeroBin (fun j => momentData (η j))
          p.lower p.upper p.height ⟨u.val, u.property.1⟩) →
        (F.card : ℝ) ≤ K*(1+|p.height|)^A*Y^(unmarkedDensity (2*p.lower-1)+loss)) ∧
      (∀ p : DensityWindow, ∀ Y : ℝ, 0 < Y →
        ∀ R : Finset ProbePhysical.NonzeroFrequency,
        (∀ u ∈ R, rawFrequencyNorm u ≤ Y ∧ rawZeroBin (fun j => momentData (η j))
          p.lower p.upper p.height u) →
        (R.card : ℝ) ≤ K*(1+|p.height|)^A*Y^(unmarkedDensity (2*p.lower-1)+loss))
title: actual_momentData_density

theorem actual_source_rows_fixed_parent (η : Character) (C D : Ideal O)
    (hC : Supported C) (E : Finset (CommonIndex C D)) (ξ₁ ξ₂ : RayCharacter)

      activeConductor C D = (u : O) * ∏ i, activePrimary C D i ∧
      ∀ j : O, ∀ t : ℝ, ∀ I : Ideal O,
        (rowWeight F.left fixedBadMask 1 j t I =
          rowWeight τL fixedBadMask 1
            (primeSubsetGenerator (fun P : CommonIndex C D => P.val) E *
              (u : O) * leftEffectiveFactor C D * j) t I *
            leftCanceledMask C D (primaryGenerator I)) ∧
        (rowWeight F.right fixedBadMask 1 j t I =
          rowWeight τR fixedBadMask 1
            (primeSubsetGenerator (fun P : CommonIndex C D => P.val) E *
              (u : O) * rightEffectiveFactor C D * j) t I *
            rightCanceledMask C D (primaryGenerator I))

theorem actual_unmarked_batch_count {Label : Type*} [Fintype Label]
    (η : Label → Character) (Q : Ideal O) [NeZero Q]
    (hQtop : Q ≠ ⊤) (hQ72 : Q ≤ Ideal.span {(72 : O)})
    (hQη : ∀ label, Q ≤ (η label).modulus)
    (hβ : (51/100 : ℝ) ≤ HeckeZeroSupremum.beta)
    (M : Ideal O) [NeZero M] (H : Subgroup (O ⧸ M)ˣ)
    (hH : RayOrthogonality.globalUnits M ≤ H) (S : Finset (Ideal O))
    (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ) (hφc : HasCompactSupport φ)
    (hφp : tsupport φ ⊆ Ioi 0) (hφ0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ φ y) (hφne : φ ≠ 0)
    (a₀ b₀ B₀ : ℝ) (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) (hab₀ : a₀ ≤ b₀) (hB₀ : 0 < B₀)
    (hφs : Function.support φ ⊆ Ioo a₀ b₀) (hφB : ∀ y, φ y ≤ B₀)
    (εm : ℝ) (hεm : 0 < εm) :
    ∃ J : ℕ, ∃ C K₀ : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ 0 ≤ K₀ ∧
      ∀ᶠ U : ℝ in atTop, 1 < U ∧
        ∀ (a ε T allowance height : ℝ) (i : ℕ),
        1/2 ≤ a → 2*a-1 ≤ 5/6 → 0 ≤ ε → ε ≤ 1/1000 →
        0 ≤ height → 2*Real.pi*allowance+(3*i : ℕ)*T ≤ height →
        ∀ (B : UnmarkedBatch Label U a ε (unmarkedCutoff (2*a-1)) T allowance i),
        B.data = (fun label => momentData (η label)) →
        (B.rows.card : ℝ) ≤ (Fintype.card Label : ℝ)*(dyadicLength U : ℝ)^2 *
          fiberConstant (C*(1+height)^J) height K₀ *
            U^(unmarkedDensity (2*a-1)+156*ε+εm)
title: actual_unmarked_batch_count

statement:
theorem actual_allocated_buffered_profiles
    (W₁ W₂ : ℝ → ℂ) (a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂ : ℝ)
    (ha₁ : 0 < a₁) (ha₂ : 0 < a₂)
    (hs₁ : Function.support W₁ ⊆ Icc a₁ b₁) (hW₁ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W₁)
    (hs₂ : Function.support W₂ ⊆ Icc a₂ b₂) (hW₂ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W₂) :
    ∃ C : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ k, 0 < C k) ∧
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (edge e : ℝ), edge ≤ 1 → e ≤ 1/1000 →
      ∀ {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι],
      ∀ (M : Ideal O) [NeZero M] (H : Subgroup (O ⧸ M)ˣ)
        (η : Character) (w : NonzeroElement) (parent : JointParentLabel η)
        (N : NaturalRow parent.val w.val) (puncture : Ideal O) (hpuncture : puncture ≠ 0)
        (D : Ideal O) (allocation : Allocation D (Finset.univ : Finset (ι ⊕ Fin 2)))
        (Z d X₁ X₂ : ℝ) (η₀ : ι → Character) (V : ι → ℝ → ℂ) (b P : ι → ℝ)
        (t : ℝ) (bin : ℕ),
      1 < Z^d → 0 < X₁ → 0 < X₂ → (∀ i, 0 < P i) →
      1 ≤ (X₁/(Ideal.absNorm (selectedPlain D allocation 0) : ℝ))*b₁ →
      1 ≤ (X₂/(Ideal.absNorm (selectedPlain D allocation 1) : ℝ))*b₂ →
      ∃ P₁ P₂ : BufferedPlainProfile n C edge e,
        P₁.W = dilated W₁ (clipDilation (X₁/(Ideal.absNorm (selectedPlain D allocation 0) : ℝ))) ∧
        P₂.W = dilated W₂ (clipDilation (X₂/(Ideal.absNorm (selectedPlain D allocation 1) : ℝ))) ∧
        P₁.σ = 0 ∧ P₂.σ = 0 ∧ P₁.freq = t ∧ P₂.freq = t ∧
        ‖allocatedPositiveRow parent.val (fixedBadMask*idealGenerator puncture) 1 w.val t
          (fun i => primePool M H (b i) (P i))
          (fun i I => idealCoeff (η₀ i).inverse I*V i ((I.absNorm : ℝ)/P i)) P
          D allocation W₁ W₂ X₁ X₂‖^2 =
        ‖(allocatedBufferedData parent N puncture hpuncture D allocation P₁ P₂ Z d X₁ X₂ P t bin).value
          M H (fun i : liveIndices D allocation => η₀ i.val)
          (fun i : liveIndices D allocation => V i.val) (fun i : liveIndices D allocation => b i.val) Z d‖^2
title: actual_allocated_buffered_profiles

theorem buffered_count_of_bin_counts
    {Label : Type*} [Fintype Label]
    (χ : FreeRow → Label → Character)
    (hχ : ∀ u j, (χ u j).residue ≠ 1)
    (rows : Finset FreeRow) (U T e K E a₀ : ℝ) (I : ℕ)
    (hU : 1 < U) (hT : 2 < T) (he : 0 < e) (hesmall : e < 1 / 1000)
    (hI : 0 < I) (hwidth : (49 / 100 : ℝ) ≤ (I : ℝ) * e)
    (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hβupper : HeckeZeroSupremum.beta ≤ 7 / 8)
    (ha₀ : 167 / 200 ≤ a₀) (ha₀upper : a₀ ≤ 7 / 8)
    (hinitial : ∀ u ∈ rows, a₀ ≤ zeroMaximum (χ u) (hχ u) T)
    (hcount : ∀ s : Finset FreeRow, s ⊆ rows → ∀ a : ℝ, ∀ i : ℕ,
      i ≤ I → 51 / 100 < a → a ≤ 7 / 8 →
      (∀ u ∈ s, zeroMaximum (χ u) (hχ u) (3 * ((i : ℝ) + 1) * T) < a + 2 * e) →
      (∀ u ∈ s, a ≤ zeroMaximum (χ u) (hχ u) (3 * (i : ℝ) * T)) →
      (s.card : ℝ) ≤ K * U ^ (unmarkedDensity (2 * a - 1) + E)) :
    (rows.card : ℝ) ≤ ((I : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 *
      (K * U ^ (unmarkedDensity (2 * a₀ - 1) + E + 3 * e))

statement:
theorem actual_first_columns_reconstruct (C D : Ideal O) (hC : Supported C) :
    ∃ u : Oˣ,
      activeConductor C D = (u : O) * ∏ i, activePrimary C D i ∧
      ∀ e n : O, Supported (Ideal.span {n}) → goodLambda ^ 2 ∣ n-1 →
      (leftCoefficient e (activeConductor C D)
          (finiteSexticRow (activePrime C D) (activeGood C D hC) (activeExponent C D)) n =
        idealRowHom (e * (u : O) * leftEffectiveFactor C D) (Ideal.span {n}) *
          (∏ i, sexticReciprocityPhase (activePrimary C D i) n ^ activeExponent C D i) *
          (∏ i, if activeExponent C D i = 5 then
            if IsCoprime n (activePrimary C D i) then (1 : ℂ) else 0 else 1)) ∧
      (rightCoefficient e (activeConductor C D)
          (finiteSexticRow (activePrime C D) (activeGood C D hC) (activeExponent C D)) n =
        idealRowHom (e * (u : O) * rightEffectiveFactor C D) (Ideal.span {n}) *
          (∏ i, sexticReciprocityPhase (activePrimary C D i) n ^ (6-activeExponent C D i)) *
          (∏ i, if activeExponent C D i = 1 then
            if IsCoprime n (activePrimary C D i) then (1 : ℂ) else 0 else 1))
title: actual_first_columns_reconstruct

    (q : FirstJointLabel ι) (s : Input ι) (left : Bool)

      N (q.sideCommon (!left)) R seed (q.sideSubset left) (q.sideParent left)
      upper Z K sigma delta reserve =

      (q.sideWidth (!left) Z)
      (nominalLog (q.sideCommon left) (q.sideCommon (!left))
        (Ideal.span {q.puncture}) K (volume s) Z)
      (q.sideWidth left Z) sigma delta reserve P
      (fun B => τ (liveIndices B.val) (q.sideParent left))
